name: ct_pelvis
description: Order a CT pelvis to evaluate pelvic organs, osseous pelvis, bladder, rectum, gynecologic structures, and pelvic lymph nodes.

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., pelvic pain, mass, trauma, cancer staging)

when_to_use: pelvic pain with diagnostic uncertainty (appendicitis vs gynecologic cause)
pelvic mass characterization in males or females
staging of pelvic malignancies (bladder, rectal, cervical, prostate)
pelvic trauma evaluation (especially after high-energy injury)
complicated pelvic abscess or post-surgical complications

examples.query: Female patient with lower abdominal pain, fever, adnexal tenderness

args.clinical_indication: pelvic pain, rule out tubo-ovarian abscess
